ruleContent.content: @js:var Jsoup = Packages.org.jsoup.Jsoup; var Parser = Packages.org.jsoup.parser.Parser; var doc = (result && typeof result.select === 'function') ? result : Jsoup.parse(String(result)); var els = doc.select('div#ChapterContents'); var out = ''; if (els.size() > 0) { var e = els.get(0); var tp = e.select('div#content_tip'); if (tp.size() > 0) { tp.get(0).remove(); } var htm = String(e.html()); var c1 = htm.indexOf('txt下载地址'); if (c1 > -1) { htm = htm.substring(0, c1); } var NL = String.fromCharCode(10); var SP = String.fromCharCode(32); var NB = String.fromCharCode(160); htm = htm.replace(/<br[^>]*>/gi, NL); htm = htm.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, SP); var raw = Parser.unescapeEntities(htm, true); raw = raw.split(NB).join(SP); var ads = ['txt', 'http', 'www.', '.com', '.net', '.cc', '.vip', '.top', '.xyz', '77dushu', '77shuku', '最新网址', '请收藏本站', '全文免费阅读', '全集txt', '记住77', '牢记网址', '无弹窗', '最快更新', '手机版', '手机端', '章节报错', 'APP', 'app下载', '盗版', '请分享']; function hasCJK(s) { for (var c = 0; c < s.length; c++) { var z = s.charCodeAt(c); if (z >= 19968 && z <= 40869) { return true; } } return false; } var lines = raw.split(NL); var res = []; for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) { var ln = String(lines[i]).replace(/ +/g, SP).trim(); if (ln.length == 0) { continue; } var low = ln.toLowerCase(); var bad = false; for (var k = 0; k < ads.length; k++) { if (low.indexOf(ads[k].toLowerCase()) > -1) { bad = true; break; } } if (bad) { continue; } if (ln.length <= 8 && !hasCJK(ln)) { continue; } res.push(ln); } out = res.join(NL + NL); } out;

ruleToc.chapterList: @js:var Jsoup = Packages.org.jsoup.Jsoup; var doc = (result && typeof result.select === 'function') ? result : Jsoup.parse(String(result)); var out = []; var seen = {}; var ds = doc.select('div.zjbox dd a'); for (var i = 0; i < ds.size(); i++) { var u = String(ds.get(i).attr('href')); var t = String(ds.get(i).text()).trim(); if (u.indexOf('/chapter/') < 0 || t.length == 0) { continue; } if (seen[u]) { continue; } seen[u] = 1; out.push(String(JSON.stringify({name: t, url: u}))); } out;
